name: Amira Fatmah P. Quila?pio, RN, NURSE SPECIALIST, USRN
role: NEXT GEN NCLEX- RN PASSER New York
testimonial: Stop doubting yourself, work hard, and make it happen. First of all, thank you Allah (SWT) for this incredible blessing. I’m a Nurse working here in Riyadh, KSA. During the review, I was only able to attend 1 live online review session due to the time difference and mostly used my Artemis360 account to view recorded videos and answer practice tests. The NGN type of questions in Artemis360 are very similar in format and difficulty to the questions I encountered during the exam. I felt more confident in taking my NCLEX this time because I knew that Gapuz prepared me well for this exam. Thank you Gapuz Review Academy and Dr. Mia Gapuz for the thorough review especially the intensive final coaching which helped me a lot. I am now a USRN and I’m forever grateful

name: Frendchie Kei Arenas, USRN
role: NEXT GEN NCLEX- RN PASSER New Mexico
testimonial: I am a BSN 2009 graduate and had my PHRN in the same year. It’s been a decade since and finally, I’ve decided to take the NCLEX- RN Exam this 2023. The preparation for the NCLEX-RN exam was tough but with the innovative technology of Dra. Mia Gapuz's Artemis360 and after 3 months of intensive review, on October 19, 2023, my computer shut down at 85 items for 3 hours and 30 minutes, and I passed the NCLEX- RN on my 1st attempt. To my test masters Profs. Gregg, Gio and Clement, your test-taking strategies made it easier for me to understand each concept. To my Gapuz processing team especially to Ms. Jordan, thank you for your encouragement and assistance. To my family and beloved partner, thank you for your support and understanding and of course to our Almighty Creator, thank you for this wonderful blessing!”

The lecturers and Artemis360 played a big role in my success, from the hassle-free access to video recordings to the up-to-date mock tests and of course the in-depth knowledge of every lecturer. I want to thank all of the staff members especially Miss Jordan, and Ma’am Armi, to Doc Mia for her unwavering guidance, to Sir Greg, Sir Gio, and Sir Belvis who bestowed an enormous chunk of knowledge, motivation, and advice, and of course, to God who answered every prayer, sweat, and tears and for calling me to his will.
